title: Record timeline: compact rows name no actor, and an audit reader sees every action twice
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

From a real-user walkthrough of the development flow, filed on the maintainer's word: 「第一组：会卡住人或误导人，立卡」 (2026-11-04). Measured on `main` `987ff33b88` unless a line says otherwise. Test project scaffolded with `create-objectstack@18.3.0`.

Context: #27055 made the record page one merged timeline of discussion, activity and field history.

## What a customer sees

Two people work a ticket, and the timeline on the record page reads 「已修好 @张三」 and 「更新了 Repair Ticket "打印机卡纸"：Status」 with no name on any row, so nobody can tell who did what. An administrator also sees each action twice: 「创建了 Repair Ticket」 and, beside it, a long diff, 「负责人 — → Dev Admin; Subject — → admin two rows; Equipment — → CNC-01…」.

## Measured

- **No actor:** the compact rows show none, by screenshot on `main`. The data has it: `sys_activity.actor_name` is filled on each row.
- **Twice:** on an object with `trackHistory`, one create gives one `sys_activity` row and one `sys_audit_log` row, and one update does the same (`create`, `update` in the log; `Created…`, `Updated…` in activity). The page draws both, 「动态 2」 for one create. `RecordDetailView.tsx:2388-2390` adds the audit source when `enable.trackHistory` is on.
- **Who sees it:** a reader without `sys_audit_log` access sees one row per action, measured for a member on the published 18.3.0.

## Expected

Every row says who. One action reads as one row for everyone, with the field diff available on that row for a reader allowed to see it.
